name: com.project-kiri/kiri
title: Kiri Focus Timer
description: Focus timer, Pomodoro calculator and background sounds. Returns a link that opens the Kiri timer.

tools.name: start_focus_timer
tools.description: Sets up a Kiri focus timer: a focus block of the given length, then a break, with one of Kiri's background sounds. Returns a link that opens the Kiri timer on project-kiri.com with these settings (the person presses Start there; Kiri runs in a laptop or desktop browser) and, where the chat can show it, a timer card with the same settings that can also count down in the chat. Use it when someone asks to start a focus session, a Pomodoro, a study timer, a deep work block or a 25, 50 or 90-minute timer, or wants brown noise, rain or other background sound while they work or study. The task, if given, is only shown on the card; it is not stored and not put in the link.

break_minutes.description: Length of the break after each block in minutes (1 to 30). Default: about a fifth of the block.

minutes.description: Length of the focus block in minutes (5 to 120). Default 25.

sound.description: Background sound id (see list_sounds). Default brownnoise.

task.description: Optional: what the person will work on, shown on the card.

tools.name: list_sounds
tools.description: Lists the ten background sounds Kiri plays during a focus block (brown, pink and white noise, rain, forest, fireplace, ocean waves and more), with the id to pass to start_focus_timer, a one-line description, whether it plays in full without an account, and its page on project-kiri.com. Use it when someone asks which sounds or noises they can work or study to.

tools.name: plan_focus_blocks
tools.description: Splits a list of tasks with estimated minutes into focus blocks with breaks between them (a longer break after every fourth block). Returns the blocks in order with the tasks in each, the total time, clock times when a start time is given, and a link that opens the Kiri timer set to the block and break lengths. Use it as a Pomodoro calculator: when someone asks how many Pomodoros or focus blocks their tasks will take, when they will finish, or wants to plan their day, a study session or a revision list in timed blocks with breaks. Pure arithmetic: nothing is saved and nothing is added to any task list.

block_minutes.description: Focus block length in minutes (10 to 120). Default 25.

break_minutes.description: Short break in minutes (1 to 30). Default: about a fifth of the block.

long_break_minutes.description: Break after every fourth block in minutes (1 to 60). Default: what the Kiri timer uses for these lengths.

sound.description: Optional background sound id for the link.

start_time.description: Optional start time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock, to get clock times.

tasks.description: Tasks in the order to do them.
